# Sanitizer ignore-list for vendored code (used by LISA_SANITIZE builds).
#
# Each entry names one function in third-party code, with the reason.
# Vendored code is not modified (third_party/README.md); findings in LISA's
# own code are never ignored here.

# ggml (llama.cpp v0.4.1), ggml/src/ggml.c: ggml_graph_nbytes computes a
# graph's memory layout by advancing a NULL pointer through
# incr_ptr_aligned and reading back the offset. The pointer is never
# dereferenced. UBSan reports "applying non-zero offset to null pointer".
fun:incr_ptr_aligned
